resources.string: Changes made while the reader is offline land here: statuses, shelves, notes, deletions, sleep screens, fonts, settings and books from “Share → FolioLink”.
Changes go to the reader in order. Ones the reader rejects stay here with the error until you retry or delete them.
The reader is not connected. Everything is sent in order on the next connection.
Requires a newer FolioLink — this change can only be deleted
For another reader — goes out when that one connects
The change will not be sent to the reader. The app’s data refreshes on the next sync.
The damaged queue file is kept on the phone and was not overwritten. Books found in its folders were restored above.
